advisories.reason: Pulled in by the Prisma CLI's config loader (@prisma/config), which merges our own prisma.config.ts at migrate/generate time only; never loaded by the app server, and its input is not attacker-controlled. The only fix offered is downgrading to Prisma 6.
Dependency of the Prisma CLI's local dev server (@prisma/dev); this project uses Postgres and never opens a MySQL connection. The only fix offered is downgrading to Prisma 6.
nodemailer@8 installed only as Auth.js's optional peer for its email-login provider, which is not configured. App email goes through backend/src/email.ts on nodemailer@10, which is patched.
